purpose: Standalone nonofficial policies and questions for RAARA project demonstrations only. No policy is attributed to PES University or any actual institution.

policies.title: Illustrative minimum attendance
policies.exact_text: For this RAARA demonstration only, the illustrative minimum attendance is 75%. This value is project-authored and is not an official university requirement or a universal standard.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Attendance percentage calculation
policies.exact_text: Illustrative attendance percentage is calculated as (classes attended / classes held) x 100. Round only for display to two decimal places; eligibility decisions are outside this generic example.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Attendance shortfall calculation
policies.exact_text: For this demonstration, compare calculated attendance with the illustrative 75% value. The difference is described in percentage points. This does not define condonation or eligibility.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Attendance exceptions are unspecified
policies.exact_text: This project dataset does not define medical exemptions, condonation, special attendance relaxation, or the evidence required for such exceptions. Those questions require an applicable institution-issued rule.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: No exemption policy is supplied; do not infer one from the illustrative 75% threshold.

policies.title: Illustrative assessment weights
policies.exact_text: In this project model, the illustrative course score uses internal assessment weight 40% and end-semester examination weight 60%. These are project assumptions, not official or universal weights.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Weighted course score formula
policies.exact_text: Illustrative total score = (internal score x 0.40) + (end-semester score x 0.60), assuming both component scores are on a 0-100 scale. Actual assessment schemes may differ.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Assessment worked example
policies.exact_text: Worked project example: internal score 34/100 and end-semester score 52/100 produce (34 x 0.40) + (52 x 0.60) = 13.6 + 31.2 = 44.8/100.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Illustrative overall passing score
policies.exact_text: For this demonstration, an illustrative overall weighted score of at least 40/100 is a pass. The project does not add a separate minimum examination score. Actual institutions may set additional or different component requirements.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: No separate minimum exam score is defined here; actual institution-specific component requirements may differ.

policies.title: Illustrative ten-point scale
policies.exact_text: This project demonstration uses grade points on an illustrative 10-point scale. The scale is project-authored and is not asserted to match any university grading scheme.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Illustrative score-to-grade table
policies.exact_text: Project-only sample table for integer percentage scores: 90-100 : 10 points; 80-89 : 9; 70-79 : 8; 60-69 : 7; 50-59 : 6; 40-49 : 5; 0-39 : 0. This is a transparent example, not an institutional conversion table.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Illustrative SGPA formula
policies.exact_text: For the project model, SGPA = sum(course credits x course grade point) / sum(course credits) for courses included in the stated term. Actual university inclusion, exclusions, repeats, and rounding can differ.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: SGPA worked example
policies.exact_text: Worked project example: course values (4 credits, 9 points), (3 credits, 8 points), and (3 credits, 7 points) give (4x9 + 3x8 + 3x7) / (4+3+3) = 81 / 10 = 8.10.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Illustrative cumulative CGPA formula
policies.exact_text: For this project model, CGPA = sum(course credit x course grade point) / sum(all included course credits) across the stated cumulative set. Actual institutional treatment of repeats, exclusions, and rounding may differ.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: CGPA worked example
policies.exact_text: Worked project example: a term block of 10 credits at 8.10 and another of 20 credits at 7.50 gives (10x8.10 + 20x7.50) / 30 = 231 / 30 = 7.70.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Illustrative backlog meaning
policies.exact_text: In this demonstration, a backlog means a course requirement remains uncleared after the student does not meet the applicable passing rule. This definition is only a generic example.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Actual terminology and consequences depend on the governing institution and cohort rules.

policies.title: Illustrative course-clearing concept
policies.exact_text: In this project model, a student clears an illustrative failed course by completing the institution-authorized assessment opportunity and satisfying the applicable passing criteria. This dataset does not define a real attempt process.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Do not infer attempt limits, eligibility, or exam dates from this generic statement.

policies.title: Supplementary attempts and dates unspecified
policies.exact_text: This generic dataset does not specify the maximum number of supplementary examination attempts, student eligibility conditions, or supplementary examination dates.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Questions about attempt limits, eligibility, or dates must be unanswered from this dataset.

policies.title: Illustrative revaluation request process
policies.exact_text: A generic project demonstration process is: consult the applicable examination notice, submit the prescribed request through the institution-designated channel, provide required course/exam details, and retain the acknowledgement. This is illustrative workflow guidance, not an official procedure.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Actual process, eligibility, fees, and channel are institution-specific.

policies.title: Revaluation deadlines unspecified
policies.exact_text: No fixed revaluation deadline or eligibility window is defined by this project dataset. Use only a current institution-issued examination notice for real deadlines.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Do not invent or infer a fixed deadline.

policies.title: Illustrative course registration process
policies.exact_text: A generic registration workflow is to review the available course list and prerequisites, select eligible courses through the institution-designated system, and confirm the recorded registration. This is a project illustration only.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Actual prerequisites, approval, add/drop, and withdrawal rules are institution-specific.

policies.title: Registration dates unspecified
policies.exact_text: This dataset defines no course registration, add/drop, or withdrawal deadlines. Those dates and conditions require an applicable institution-issued calendar or notice.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: No institutional deadline is provided.

policies.title: Course credits and workload
policies.exact_text: Credits are a course-level unit used in the project examples to weight academic work in calculations. This dataset does not define contact hours, workload equivalence, or a universal credit standard.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Credit-to-hours mappings vary and are not specified.

policies.title: Illustrative three-credit example
policies.exact_text: For a worked example only, a course may be represented as 3 credits. This value demonstrates how credits weight an SGPA/CGPA formula; it does not define a real course or workload.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Illustrative project content only; actual institutions and admission batches may use different rules.

policies.title: Illustrative academic progression concepts
policies.exact_text: Academic progression can depend on course completion, credits earned, prerequisites, and academic standing. This project record names possible factors but sets no actual promotion threshold.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: The factors are illustrative; no student-specific decision can be made from this record.

policies.title: Promotion criteria are institution-specific
policies.exact_text: This dataset does not define promotion, probation, year-back, prerequisite, or minimum-credit criteria for any institution or admission batch. Such criteria must come from current applicable regulations.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Do not infer promotion eligibility from the generic dataset.

policies.title: Generic academic calendar periods
policies.exact_text: A generic academic calendar may identify semester teaching, registration, examination, and result periods. This dataset describes period types only and contains no real PES University dates.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Dates and institutional schedules are not supplied.

policies.title: Academic calendar dates unspecified
policies.exact_text: No real institutional semester, registration, examination, or result dates are defined in this project dataset.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Do not produce dates from this record.

policies.title: Synthetic attendance example version 0.9
policies.exact_text: Project-only conflict fixture, version 0.9: the illustrative minimum attendance is 70%. This fictional earlier project example is not a university regulation and is included only to test version conflict handling.
policies.applicability: RAARA project demonstration only; not institution- or batch-specific.
limitations: Deliberately conflicts with project-authored version 1.0; neither version is official.
